en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains; showers easing into the new week
en.dek: The Observatory expects the northeast monsoon to keep affecting southern China through the middle of the week, with showers mainly at first and gradual improvement later.
body: The Strong Monsoon Signal remained in force on Sunday afternoon. The Hong Kong Observatory said strong easterly winds with mean speeds exceeding 40 kilometres per hour were expected, and gusts could occasionally reach gale force.

A special weather tip issued earlier in the morning warned that a rain band south of Hong Kong was approaching and that heavier showers with squally thunderstorms were likely in places for a few hours. The Leisure and Cultural Services Department also hoisted red flags at several beaches because of big waves.

Looking ahead, the Observatory said a northeast monsoon would continue to affect the south China coast into the middle of the coming week. Showers are expected mainly on Monday, with more sunshine likely in the following days as a tropical depression over the central South China Sea moves away towards Vietnam and upper-level conditions improve.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號仍然生效 新一週初段仍有驟雨
zh.dek: 天文台表示東北季候風將繼續影響華南至本週中後期，初段仍有驟雨，其後天色逐漸好轉。
body: 強烈季候風信號於周日下午仍然生效。天文台表示，預料本港吹偏東強風，平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
天文台早上曾發出特別天氣提示，指本港以南雷雨帶逐漸靠近，未來兩三小時部分地區雨勢較大及有狂風雷暴。康文署亦因大浪在多個泳灘懸掛紅旗。
展望方面，一股東北季候風會在今日至本週中後期持續影響華南。位於南海中部的熱帶低氣壓將移向越南沿岸，預料初段仍有幾陣驟雨，隨後兩三日部分時間有陽光，天色逐漸好轉。
